title: Profile of Offenders and Fines Issued under Tray Return Campaign
what_it_is: Profile of Offenders and Fines Issued under Tray Return Campaign

sections.label: Table littering enforcement at hawker centres
sections.summary: Enforcement against table littering at hawker centres began 1 September 2021 after a three-month advisory period, with written warnings for first offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Enforcement action against table littering at hawker centres started on 1 September 2021, following a three-month advisory period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Diners who refuse to heed officers' advice will have their particulars taken down and be issued written warnings if it is their first offence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Only second or subsequent offenders will be issued fines or sent to Court.

sections.label: Written warning and coffeeshop enforcement
sections.summary: One written warning has been issued, and enforcement at coffeeshops and food courts starts 1 January 2022 after a two-month advisory period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To date, one written warning has been issued to a diner for refusing to heed enforcement officers' advice to return the dirty crockery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Singapore Food Agency will also be commencing enforcement against table littering at coffeeshops and food courts from 1 January 2022, with a two-month advisory period from 1 November 2021 to 31 December 2021.

sections.label: Average age of cleaners
sections.summary: The average age of cleaners is 60 years today.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The average age of our cleaners is 60 years today.

sections.label: ESPSG first tranche applications
sections.summary: The first ESPSG tranche concluded in August 2021 with 1,700 applications approved and $40.75 million committed, and about 1,200 applications are being assessed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The first tranche of the ESPSG has concluded in August 2021 with a very strong demand, overwhelming demand indeed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have approved 1,700 applications and committed a grant of $40.75 million.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are assessing the rest of the applications – about 1,200 to commit the remainder fund.
